tools.description: Name a Request with a short user-facing title (a few words, at most 60 characters, in the user's language, saying what it is about; never a copy of the prompt). Do this for every Request you split into Tasks, before creating its second Task: create_task refuses it on an untitled Request.
tools.name: title_request

tools.description: Create a cohesive Task under an open Request, with its launch plan (required), so Alondra starts it by itself when there is room and what it depends on is done. Dependencies are waits: the Task starts, or its node goes on, once they are done, and they never hold back the merge of a PR it presented; a PR built on another Task's open PR uses stack, which merges after it. A phase of an approved plan takes its points with plan_items: their numbers in the plan and the Task of this Request that holds them now; they leave that Task, which keeps the rest.

launch.description: How Alondra starts this Task by itself once everything it depends on is done: required when dependencies or stack are set

cwd.description: The folder the node starts in

mission.description: The node's mission; without it, the task title and the request

model.description: Required when the request's effort is auto

name.description: The new node's name, with its hierarchy (lumo/phase-c)

reason.description: Required when the request's effort is auto

role.description: For work split into design, implementation and review

tools.name: create_task

tools.description: Answer a question addressed to the orchestrator: option_id is the option chosen (empty for an answer in your own words), and inputs.text your words, alone or with it. Every question a node asks you gets its answer here: an answer written only in your conversation never reaches the node. A node's suggestion is settled with settle_suggestion instead.
tools.name: answer_question
tasks_in_progress
tools.description: Work in progress: unfinished nodes that are running, dormant or owe the user something, with what they run in the background (subagents and shells, each since when it runs); open questions, unread reports, undelivered messages for you, and the machine.

tools.name: close_request
tools.description: Close a Request that needs no Task. State the answer or mark it withdrawn. The answer is the Request's record; if you sent no card, Alondra shows it to the user as one, except for a maintenance message, which gets none.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a message to a node; Alondra types it into the node's session (waking it if it is dormant). With task, the message is about that task, which must be the node's own: a node works only on the task it was launched for, and a closed task's node is closed with it.

task.description: The id of the task (t-…) the message is about

tools.name: set_launch_plan
tools.description: Replace the launch plan Alondra starts a task with by itself when the node limit has room and everything it depends on is done.
